description: This Kotlin source file defines a class FirebaseSyncSubscriber that implements the SyncSubscriber interface. The class subscribes to a Firebase Cloud Messaging topic (SYNC_TOPIC) when its subscribe() method is called. It relies on dependency injection to receive an instance of FirebaseMessaging.

classes.name: FirebaseSyncSubscriber
classes.description: Implementation of [SyncSubscriber] that subscribes to the FCM [SYNC_TOPIC]

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Suspend function that uses FirebaseMessaging to subscribe to the SYNC_TOPIC and waits for the operation to complete.
